mentions.name: Multimodal Model Interpretability Tool
mentions.description: This project aims to make interpretability research practical, providing early results analyzing the reasoning of large multimodal models. It is still at an early stage with no demo yet.
mentions.problem: Interpretability research is currently not practical.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying to make interpretability research practical. A bit early for the demo, but I am getting some interesting results for large multimodal models in terms of their reasoning.
